description: French company search by name or SIREN/SIRET number. Searches the official French company directory (INSEE Sirene and the national register). Returns SIREN, name, legal form code, activity code, creation date, whether the company is active, size category, head office address and up to 5 directors. Use for KYB in France. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
